title: Juicy Crunchy Italian Vegetable Salad
description: A refreshing Italian salad featuring marinated vegetables, perfect for a light lunch or dinner. This dish is macrobiotic-friendly and showcases the flavors of Italy.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced zucchini, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Pour the marinade over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Let the vegetables marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Just before serving, stir in chopped fresh basil.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional basil if desired.
This salad can be made ahead of time and stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
Before serving, give the salad a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the salad as a light lunch or dinner, or as a side dish for a larger meal.
